Teaser Released for Rashmika Mandanna's Action Film 'Mysaa'

The teaser for the upcoming film 'Mysaa' starring Rashmika Mandanna was released. The preview shows Mandanna in a rugged, fearless warrior role and features intense action sequences. One outlet notes that the story involves a distinctive father‑daughter relationship. No release date for the full film was provided.
